$comment: Value and roughness bands per material family, from docs/ART.md §7.2. 'albedo' bounds the median linear luminance (Rec. 709 on linear RGB) of the untinted base color; 'roughness' bounds the median of ORM green. Every texel of the base color, untinted and under every tint preset, stays inside the hard limits at its 0.5th/99.5th percentiles: dielectric linear 0.013-0.90 (ART.md §7.2 'Hard limits'), metal F0 0.50-1.00 (ART.md §7.2 bare steel F0 0.56, aluminium 0.91, less the ±10 % of §3). 'source' is 'ART.md' when §7.2 gives the numbers and 'derived' when it does not (each derived band is a hook request to the art director). tests/materials.test.js and tools/materials/build.py read this file.

plaster_paint.source: ART.md §7.2 plaster walls (0.60 assumed, 0.45-0.65 allowed; roughness 0.85-0.95)

tile_ceramic.source: ART.md §7.2 white ceramic tiles (0.75 assumed, one sample 0.878; glazed 0.15-0.30)

grout.source: ART.md §7.2 'Grout 0.30-0.45 decided'; roughness derived (cementitious, no highlights like plaster)

concrete.source: derived: ART.md §7.2 terracotta / pavers row (0.20-0.35, 0.7-0.9), the nearest cementitious floor

leather.source: derived: ART.md §7.2 'sneaker rubber and leather' roughness 0.4-0.6; albedo from the lowered floor 'so that black leather fits' up to the clothing band's 0.30

laminate.source: derived: a wood-print decor, so ART.md §7.2 wood floors (albedo and satin roughness)

metal_bare.source: ART.md §7.2 metal: bare steel metalness 1, F0 0.56, aluminium F0 0.91; bare 0.2-0.4

metal_painted.source: ART.md §7.2 metal: painted is dielectric, 0.05-0.15 (dark door) to 0.70-0.80 (white enamel); painted 0.35-0.6

glass.source: ART.md §7.2 glass: F0 0.04, transmission 0.9, roughness 0.05 (dirty 0.25); the base color is a transmission tint, near white

rubber.source: derived: ART.md §7.2 hard-limit floor 0.013 lowered 'so that black leather, rubber and dark cloth fit'; 'sneaker rubber' roughness 0.4-0.6

cardboard.source: derived: unbleached kraft between ART.md §7.2 terracotta (0.20-0.35) and fabric; matte like plaster (0.85-0.95)

plastic.source: derived: a pigmented dielectric shell like ART.md §7.2 painted metal (0.05-0.80, 0.35-0.6), floor lowered to black housings

bark.source: derived: between ART.md §7.2 stained wood (0.10-0.20) and foliage (0.13-0.16); unfinished, rough like pavers (0.7-0.9)

soil.source: derived: darker than ART.md §7.2 terracotta (0.20-0.35) since moist; matte

newsprint.source: derived: off-white paper like ART.md §7.2 plaster (0.45-0.65, 0.85-0.95)

rattan.source: derived: lacquered cane from ART.md §7.2 wood floors, upper end for the lighter palm cane

changes: 2026-09-23 WP-P0-05b: bands move from sRGB mean luminance (placeholders) to ART.md §7.2 linear albedo medians and roughness medians; hard limits become linear 0.013-0.90 dielectric (ART.md §7.2) and F0 0.50-1.00 metal.
plaster_paint: mean sRGB 195-230 -> albedo 0.45-0.65, roughness 0.62-0.92 -> 0.85-0.95 (ART.md §7.2 plaster walls).
wallpaper: family retired; the woodchip wallpaper is a painted wall surface, judged as plaster_paint (ART.md §7.2 plaster walls is the on-screen wall family).
wood_floor: mean sRGB 70-170 -> albedo 0.25-0.39, roughness 0.28-0.70 -> 0.45-0.65 (ART.md §7.2 wood floors).
wood_stained: new; stained pine moves here, albedo 0.10-0.20 (ART.md §7.2 'Stained accents 0.10-0.20').
tile_ceramic: mean sRGB 150-215 -> albedo 0.70-0.90, roughness 0.04-0.95 -> 0.15-0.30 (ART.md §7.2 white ceramic tiles, glazed).
concrete: mean sRGB 100-175 -> albedo 0.20-0.35, roughness 0.60-0.96 -> 0.70-0.90 (derived from ART.md §7.2 pavers).
fabric: mean sRGB 110-215 -> albedo 0.22-0.46, roughness 0.70-0.97 -> 0.85-1.00 (ART.md §7.2 fabric).
leather: mean sRGB 140-215 -> albedo 0.02-0.30, roughness 0.30-0.72 -> 0.40-0.60 (derived from ART.md §7.2 'sneaker rubber and leather').
laminate: mean sRGB 110-200 -> albedo 0.25-0.39, roughness 0.28-0.55 -> 0.45-0.65 (derived from ART.md §7.2 wood floors).
metal_bare: mean sRGB 185-225 -> F0 0.50-1.00, roughness 0.18-0.50 -> 0.20-0.40 (ART.md §7.2 bare metal).
metal_painted: mean sRGB 140-210 -> albedo 0.05-0.80, roughness 0.28-0.75 -> 0.35-0.60 (ART.md §7.2 painted metal).
glass: mean sRGB 228-252 -> transmission tint 0.80-1.00, roughness 0.02-0.20 -> 0.05-0.25 (ART.md §7.2 glass).
rubber: mean sRGB 34-60 -> albedo 0.013-0.05, roughness 0.65-0.95 -> 0.40-0.60 (derived from ART.md §7.2 hard floor and 'sneaker rubber').
plastic, bark, soil, newsprint, rattan: new families for the new materials (derived, see 'source').
